name: Fujii Natsumi
source:
A girl who's always energetic with a bright, straightforward personality. She has plenty of male friends as well as female ones. She loves to keep up with trends and chat noisily with her friends. She often acts without thinking things through, and seems to be viewed as a natural enemy by Mr. Himuro.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
